Is condition ka saransh

Har din ka hisaab

Filter pass = 5000 cr+, price, volume, ATR, gap-up sab pass karne wale stocks. Signal = R3 ke upar close wali pehli green (buy) / red (sell) candle. Loss limit = din ka loss 2% (Rs 2 lakh) pahuncha to sab band.

Kul net profit (har trade band hone ke baad) aur drawdown

Trade jis kram me band hue, usi kram me net jodte gaye; laal = upar ke peak se kitna neeche.

Har signal: kis candle pe aaya, trigger (buy = candle ka high, sell = candle ka low), aur kya hua (trade hua ya kyun nahi).

Return % = net / shuruaati capital (Rs 1 crore).
